request.speaker: JANUS_COSMOS
request.topic: Choose the next gate after Q4A successfully froze LUCI sky-fixed versus detector-fixed geometry without new forced photometry.
request.question: Q4A passed with the frozen candidate sky coordinate and strong geometric separation between sky-fixed and detector-fixed trajectories in the bracketing frames. What should JANUS execute next to maximally discriminate H_SKY_FIXED versus H_DETECTOR_OR_BACKGROUND while preserving the frozen centroid, frames, WCS mapping, control grid, and no post-hoc recentering or control selection?
request.context: Q4A derived RA=307.3382686775776 deg, Dec=40.223696223058276 deg from the frozen B-frame candidate centroid. WCS roundtrip error is 4.47e-10 pixel. The same sky coordinate maps 163.8537 pixels away from the detector-fixed candidate pixel in A/0114 and 80.2378 pixels away in C/0120, while the B positions coincide by construction. All three 17x17 patches are in bounds. Thirteen same-y edge-matched detector controls were frozen before any new Q4 forced photometry. Q4A did not dereference image arrays and made no flux measurement. The previous external timing-replication line remains closed and must not contribute evidential credit.

cards.name: Mirror
cards.lens: Separate what is observed from what is being interpreted.
cards.question: Which assumption would change the reading most if it were false?
cards.caution: Familiarity and repetition are not evidence.

cards.name: Threshold
cards.lens: Prefer a reversible next step before an irreversible commitment.
cards.question: What is the smallest move that preserves the most future choices?

cards.name: Cat
cards.lens: When a loop becomes unproductive, change the input before arguing with the loop.
cards.question: Would a lighter neutral bridge restore perspective here?
cards.caution: A mood-reset heuristic is not treatment or proof.

heuristics: Rank the next moves by reversibility, information gain, and cost of being wrong.

janus_interpretation.mirror: Measure fixed-coordinate amplitudes and uncertainties first; origin labels are downstream interpretations and must not alter the measurement estimator.
janus_interpretation.threshold: Execute one minimal Q4B forced-photometry pass on only the three frozen LUCI1 Br-gamma frames and the already-frozen 13 detector controls.
janus_interpretation.cat: Do not reopen cross-archive timing replication or add new epochs. Change the input to direct sky-track versus detector-track photometric origin adjudication.
